title: JopaQuiz quiz set
description: A set of 4-option multiple-choice questions generated from one or more source documents. Cross-field rules not expressible here (unique ids, reference.sourceId must exist in sources) are enforced by the validation script. See schema/README.md.

$schema.description: Optional path/URL to this schema, for editor support.

format.description: Marks the file as a JopaQuiz quiz set.

formatVersion.description: Version of this file format. Bump on breaking changes.

id.description: Stable id of the quiz set. Importing a file with an existing id replaces that set.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the questions, e.g. "hr" or "en". Matches the source documents.

removedQuestionIds.description: Ids of questions removed from the set (e.g. after the source document changed). Kept so the ids are never reused; the app ignores score history for them.

id.description: Id referenced by question.reference.sourceId. Unique within the set.

title.description: Human-readable document title, if different from the file name.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the set (e.g. "q0001"). Never reused or renumbered; score history refers to it.

options.description: Exactly 4 answer options. The app shuffles their display order.

correctIndex.description: Index into options of the single correct answer.

explanation.description: One or two sentences on why the correct answer is right. Shown after answering.

sourceId.description: Id of the entry in sources that contains the answer.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the source that contains the answer. For CSV rows: "Column: value | Column: value".

headingPath.description: Headings from the top level down to the section, e.g. ["2. Protective equipment", "2.1 Helmets"]. Empty if the document has no headings.

paragraph.description: Optional 1-based paragraph number within that section.

row.description: Row number as shown in a spreadsheet app (the header row is row 1).

columns.description: Column names (header text) that hold the answer.
